regime: sign_of_contemporaneous_market_return; zero excluded in conditional models
dynamic_model: separate current-regime intercepts and interactions of current-regime indicator with all market terms; report sum of slopes for lags[0,1] and offsets[-1,0,1], a different descriptive estimand, no unbiasedness or forecast claim
weekly: W-FRI sum of daily logs; any missing constituent makes asset-week missing; discard first and last week of each panel; regime by weekly market sum; no daily reconstruction
exclusion: remove calendar sessions from target window; retain original calendar positions for daily HAC; report removed sessions; no data error asserted
individual_family: 197 decade+recent per profile; common80 reuse recent117; each new profile sensitivity only, no calibrated FWER claim after response-selected masks

bootstrap.method: synchronous noncircular moving blocks of return rows, all assets and market together, refit conditional centered slopes from sufficient statistics
bootstrap.strata: pre2021 and2021_2025; crisis exclusion divides pre2021 at its calendar gap; independently resample each contiguous segment to its observed length; common80 and recent117 use same recent draws
bootstrap.targets: mean and median of fixed-security population slopes; no security resampling, no capital/company weights
bootstrap.p_value: (1+sum(abs(Tstar-That)>=abs(That)))/(B+1); centered asymptotic bootstrap, not exact null randomization
bootstrap.confidence: 95 percent basic bootstrap intervals, marginal and approximate
bootstrap.multiplicity: Holm10 separately per block length, primary L21; additionally Holm30 across all tests and lengths; report all without selection
bootstrap.invalid_draws: abort on invalid moments or insufficient counts; never silently discard or redraw
bootstrap.limitations: local stationarity/mixing within segments and regularity; no finite-sample validity or independent prospectively untouched holdout claimed; fixed finite median may be nonregular near tied central slopes

prediction: preserve previous next-return experiment and move detailed presentation to appendix; no new future-beta prediction claimed
